title: Section 9 — Courts to try all civil suits unless barred — CPC 1908

content.heading: Courts to try all civil suits unless barred
content.text: The Courts shall (subject to the provisions herein contained) have jurisdiction to try all suits of a civil nature excepting suits of which their cognizance is either expressly or impliedly barred.
content.historicalNotes: CPC 1908 remains in force. BNSS does not repeal it.
